description: This source file implements a service class that checks if share accounts are mapped to a specific user within the Fineract platform. It provides a method to query the database and determine if a shared account is associated with a given user.

classes.name: AppUserShareAccountsMapperReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: A service class that implements methods to access share account mappings for users, specifically checking if a share account is mapped to a user.

methods.name: isShareAccountsMappedToUser
methods.description: Checks whether a share account specified by accountId is associated with the user identified by appUserId by querying the database.
